description: Shifa International Hospitals Limited (SIHL) is a JCI-accredited quaternary care hospital group based in Islamabad, offering over 45 medical specialties. Through a network of hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and laboratories, plus the eShifa digital health platform, it provides integrated care both onsite and at home. It is also engaged in organ transplantation, diagnostics, medical education, research and community service in collaboration with Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University and Shifa Foundation.
headOffice: Pitras Bukhari Road, Sector H-8/4, Islamabad, Pakistan
